scout_postings.sql:
SELECT *
FROM scout_postings
WHERE (LOWER(COALESCE(title, '')) || ' ' || LOWER(COALESCE(description, '')) || ' ' || LOWER(COALESCE(skills_json, ''))) LIKE '%r%'
  AND (LOWER(COALESCE(title, '')) || ' ' || LOWER(COALESCE(description, '')) || ' ' || LOWER(COALESCE(skills_json, ''))) LIKE '%data visualization%'
scout_postings.title: Jobs Requiring R and Data Visualization

querychat_viz_widgets.ggsql:
SELECT location_state, COUNT(*) AS job_count
FROM scout_postings
WHERE location_state IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(location_state) <> ''
GROUP BY location_state
ORDER BY job_count DESC
VISUALISE location_state AS y, job_count AS x
DRAW bar
PROJECT y, x TO cartesian
LABEL x => 'Number of jobs', y => 'State'
